# ARCELOPERA

> Portfolio and research hub of Dr. Carlos Arce-Lopera, a software engineer and researcher exploring machine learning, bioacoustics, cognitive science, and immersive technologies.

ARCELOPERA showcases Dr. Arce-Lopera's work spanning academic teaching, software development, bioacoustics monitoring systems, and innovative applications of VR and biometric sensing. The site documents research projects, educational initiatives, and technical resources across multiple domains.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Cognitive Science
- Bioacoustics Monitoring
- Digital Signal Processing
- Virtual Reality
- Biometric Sensing
- Human Perception
- Data Visualization
- Software Engineering
- Python Programming
- User-Centered Design
- Sensory Perception
- Experimental Psychology
- Online Education
- Personalized Learning

## Professional Profile

- [About - ARCELOPERA](https://arcelopera.github.io/about): Personal profile of Dr. Carlos Arce-Lopera, software engineer and researcher.

## Education & Teaching

- [Teaching - ARCELOPERA](https://arcelopera.github.io/teaching): Teaching philosophy and university courses in Python, C#, and research methods.
- [Powershell Refresher Website - ARCELOPERA](https://arcelopera.github.io/automation/PWSHRefresh): PowerShell tutorials and exercises for scripting skills and automation.

## Bioacoustics & Biodiversity Research

- [New WikiAves Colombia Website is Live! - ARCELOPERA](https://arcelopera.github.io/bioacoustics%20monitoring%20systems/WikiAves): Launch announcement of redesigned WikiAves Colombia biodiversity platform.
- [Designing Data Visualization Assistance for a Bioacoustics Labeling Software - ARCELOPERA](https://arcelopera.github.io/bioacoustics%20monitoring%20systems/HCII21_1): User-centered design for bioacoustics data visualization and species classification.

## Immersive Technologies & Biometric Systems

- [Training birdsong recognition using virtual reality - ARCELOPERA](https://arcelopera.github.io/gaming/education/VRIH_TrainingBirdSongVR): VR-based training system for birdsong recognition with engagement metrics.
- [Handgrip Force Sensor to Measure Mental Workload - ARCELOPERA](https://arcelopera.github.io/gaming/biometric%20monitoring%20systems/HCII21_2): Handgrip force sensor system for measuring mental workload via biometrics.
